mapper.select: SELECT item_text as name, item_value as `value` FROM `sys_dict_item` WHERE dict_id = ( SELECT id FROM sys_dict WHERE dict_code='screen_left_two_class_name' ) ORDER BY sort_order ASC;

SELECT sdi.item_text AS xData, sm.title AS `name`, CONCAT(sm.color_one, ',', sm.color_two) AS colors, IFNULL(SUM(sd.value), 0) AS `value` FROM sys_dict_item sdi LEFT JOIN screen_left_two_data sd ON sdi.item_value = sd.class_name LEFT JOIN screen_left_two_main sm ON sd.group_id = sm.id WHERE sdi.dict_id = (SELECT id FROM sys_dict WHERE dict_code='screen_left_two_class_name') AND `type` = #{type} GROUP BY sdi.item_text, sm.title, sm.color_one, sm.color_two, sm.sort ORDER BY sm.sort ASC;
